Skill patched. I added a "Z-score / sample standard deviations off the average" section that captures the genuinely generalizable lesson from this question:

- The sample-vs-population std-dev trap: "sample standard deviations" means ddof=1 (statistics.stdev), the exact opposite of the TIPS "population standard deviation" question already in the skill. This is a real, recurring distinction the tight grader punishes — getting it wrong scales the answer by sqrt(N/(N-1)).
- Keep the sign (below-mean → negative z).
- N = count of years in the inclusive range; the target value is one of the N.
- Cross-referenced the existing maturity-distribution section for the data lookup.

Memory already covers the broader OfficeQA format/delimiter conventions, and this is procedural detail that belongs in the skill rather than memory, so no memory update is needed. Done.
